texts.preamble: Tallam Anjaneyulu Tellam Anjaneyulu, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 16 September, 2021 The Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Lalitha Kanneganti Criminal Petition No.5151 of 2021 Order:
texts.facts: The case of prosecution is that on 25.02.2020 at 4.00 p.m. the Sub Inspector of Police, Nagarjuna Sagar Police Station along with his staff and mediators on credible information was conducting vehicle checking at T.Road Junction, Nagarjuna Sagar and they stopped Ashok Leyland Mini truck and on inspection they found A-1, A-2 and A-4 were transporting Ganja and Khaini sachets in the said vehicle. Police arrested them and seized the contraband under the cover of mediators report. Basing on the confession of the accused, the petitioner herein was arrayed as A-10 in the above crime.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for petitioner submits that the petitioner was arrayed as A-10 in the above crime basing on the confession made by A-1 that he used to supply Ganja to the petitioner and other person. He submits that in the present crime 1500 grams of Ganja is alleged to have been seized from the accused and it is not the case of the prosecution that anything has been recovered from the petitioner. Even it is the confession of accused that they used to supply the same to the petitioner. He submits that as far as the petitioner is concerned, nothing has been seized from the petitioner and there are no allegations against the petitioner, as such his case may be considered for grant of pre-arrest bail. 5. Per contra, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that only basing on the confession of other accused, the petitioner is arrayed as A-10 and as per their confession, it is clear that A-1 used to procure Ganja and used to supply the same to the petitioner and other person.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned counsel for petitioner submits that the petitioner was arrayed as A-10 in the above crime basing on the confession made by A-1 that he used to supply Ganja to the petitioner and other person. He submits that in the present crime 1500 grams of Ganja is alleged to have been seized from the accused and it is not the case of the prosecution that anything has been recovered from the petitioner. Even it is the confession of accused that they used to supply the same to the petitioner. He submits that as far as the petitioner is concerned, nothing has been seized from the petitioner and there are no allegations against the petitioner, as such his case may be considered for grant of pre-arrest bail. 5. Per contra, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that only basing on the confession of other accused, the petitioner is arrayed as A-10 and as per their confession, it is clear that A-1 used to procure Ganja and used to supply the same to the petitioner and other person.
